# Why Aditi is spelled that way — and what it costs to get it right

There is a version of this name the early internet had to settle for: *aditi*. This is the file on how **Aditi** replaced it.

Aditi’s mythology is concentrated in the Veda’s earliest hymns: the mother of the gods whose womb is the sky, whose sons are the days of the year, and to whom the gods themselves owe their radiance. Later tradition reduced her to a genealogy — mother of Vishnu in one Purāṇic strand — but the hymns keep her cosmic: the boundlessness in which everything, including the gods, is contained.

## At a Glance

- **Restored name:** Aditi
- **ASCII form:** aditi
- **Meaning:** "Boundlessness, inexhaustible abundance, unimpaired perfection, creative power — 'Infinity', one of the most ancient of the Indian goddesses and the mother of the Ādityas."
- **Domain of influence:** Infinity, Freedom, Mother of Gods
- **Pantheon:** Sanskrit
- **Restoration:** ASCII-equivalent form
- **Original script:** अदिति
- **Series:** The Restoration Files, No. 7 of 597

## The Name Before the Marks


Spoken, the name runs `/əˈdiːti/` — “uh-DEE-tee”

## The Temple That Stands Now

The restored name is not a plaque; it is an address. The temple of **Aditi** lives at [/aditi/](/aditi/), with its mythology in the [lore halls](/aditi/lore/), its peer-reviewed record in the [Scholarly Edition](/aditi/scholars/), and its place in the pattern atlas on the [patterns floor](/aditi/patterns/).

aSCII-equivalent form

## Where the Name Stood First

No Aditi temples — her worship was the hymn itself. But the Āditya-lists structured the Vedic ritual’s year, and the solar hymns’ recitation-lists are her monument: a calendar of names kept in the Brahmins’ mouths for three millennia. The temple on the web is the newest of these addresses — the first one that fits in a pocket.

## The Archetype at Work

The [pattern atlas](/patterns/) seats this temple in **3 industries**, each match argued and weighted: **Insurance & Protection Services** (the unfettered one invoked against every bond — the oldest named protector from debt, disease, and doom.); **Astrology, Tarot & Esoteric Services** (mother of the Ādityas, the solar gods of the Vedic calendar — the zodiac's oldest family.); **Space, Astronomy & Celestial Science** (mother of the Ādityas — the solar gods whose circuit is the sky's first calendar.). The [Resonance File](/aditi/blog/resonance/) reads those seats through the myths themselves.
